A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PENME research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting and appendix reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original Counterfact editing experiments, representation analyses, threshold and scaling ablations, and appendix error analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds zsRE evaluations, retrieval-time comparisons, margin sensitivity, token-overlap analysis and PCA visualizations.

M1.justification: The projector, thresholded codebook retrieval and Algorithms 1–2 are retained. The inter-edit negatives presented as an additional constraint in v2 Section 4.1 already appear in v1 Algorithm 1 and Section 7.1. Newly documented ReLU and batch normalization details do not establish an architectural change.

E1.justification: v1 discusses zsRE but actually evaluates Counterfact. v2 adds training and evaluation on zsRE with Natural Questions locality prompts, extending coverage to question-based edits and a substantially different, low-overlap neighbourhood setting.

E2.justification: MELO becomes an evaluated comparator for T5-small and GPT2-XL in Table 1 and for retrieval timing in Appendix C. GRACE, SERAC, MEMIT and fine-tuning remain. Defer is mentioned in Section 5 but has no reported comparison, so it is not counted as an evaluated addition.

E3.justification: The added zsRE evaluation uses 1,000 edits, except the marked GRACE Llama/GPT2 results use 100, with new paraphrase and disjoint NQ splits. New designs include retrieval timing over 50–300 edits and joint margin/threshold variation. Figure 5 changes the reported pairing-threshold sweep from 0.50–0.95 in 0.05 steps to 0.50–0.90 in 0.10 steps; this reporting revision does not establish reruns.

E4.justification: v2 adds analyses of codebook growth, forgotten edits and conflicts, contrastive-margin sensitivity, dataset token overlap, and PCA representations. These test efficiency, sensitivity and separation beyond v1’s analyses. Existing layer, threshold, scaling and ROUGE error analyses remain, including the relocated Llama threshold plot.

E5.justification: New runtime Table 3 reports ± quantities, although their statistical meaning and repeated-run counts are unspecified. The existing ROUGE confidence-interval reporting and values are retained from v1 Table 3 in v2 Table 7.

E6.justification: v2 adds zsRE and MELO benchmark entries plus runtime, margin, overlap and PCA findings. For example, PENME’s zsRE Llama score is 0.984. PENME’s Counterfact values remain unchanged, while GRACE’s Counterfact Llama aggregate score changes from 0.749 to 0.666. The added results do not establish same-setting performance gains over v1.

T1.justification: v2 Equation 4 adds an explicit target definition assigning t=1 to paraphrases and t=0 to negative pairs, contradicting the adjacent prose and intended loss behaviour. This introduces a limited formal inconsistency. The inter-edit separation requirement already appears in v1’s algorithm; no theorems or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The central lexical-bias and PENME contributions remain. v2 explicitly claims an inference-speed advantage and broader relevance to representation-similarity applications such as RAG. Its conclusion also claims Counterfact generalization and locality exceed 0.80, although Table 1 retains T5-small locality of 0.787.

C2.justification: v2 adds explanations connecting GRACE/MELO cluster merging and resizing to dataset-dependent storage, forgetting and retrieval latency. It also interprets the margin study and qualifies comparisons through discussion of other works’ softer metrics. Existing failure explanations remain, and v1’s limitations are retained in Appendix H.

D1.justification: v2 newly documents ReLU, batch normalization, a selected margin of 40, threshold-axis normalization and zsRE construction. Resource notes add 80GB A100 usage, unsupported method/model combinations and reliance on authors’ implementations where EasyEdit support is limited. These expand documentation without establishing changes to the retained projector training procedure.

R1.justification: v2 adds Hase et al. on limitations of localization and replaces Chen et al. with Hadsell et al. for the contrastive objective. Related work more explicitly positions PENME against GRACE/MELO’s cluster maintenance and retrieval costs, while retaining the original research framing.

P1.justification: The abstract and substantial portions of the introduction, related work and method explanation are rewritten. Appendices are extensively reorganized, implementation details are regrouped, and Limitations moves from Section 9 to Appendix H. Parameter terminology and model naming are also revised.

P2.justification: The document switches from two columns to one, Table 1 gains dataset-grouped columns, and four tables and two PCA figures are added. Figure 5 is redrawn and its Llama panel moves to Figure 9. Figure 1’s threshold caption is corrected, but new Figure 10 incorrectly carries a T5 layer-analysis caption.

improvement.justification: The zsRE and MELO evaluations, retrieval-cost analysis and margin study strengthen evidence for claims that v1 supported more narrowly, while additional implementation details aid reproducibility. The net gain is limited by newly contradictory target labels in Equation 4, Figure 10’s mismatched caption and the conclusion’s Counterfact claim exceeding what Table 1 supports.
